solutions.explanation:
Work from the innermost parentheses outward, multiplying every term by each surrounding \(x\). First,
\[
x(2-x)-4=-x^2+2x-4.
\]
Multiplying this result by \(x\) and adding \(10\) gives
\[
x(-x^2+2x-4)+10
=-x^3+2x^2-4x+10.
\]
Finally, multiply by the outer \(x\) and add \(1\):
\[
x(-x^3+2x^2-4x+10)+1
=-x^4+2x^3-4x^2+10x+1.
\]
Thus the expression equals \(\boxed{-x^4+2x^3-4x^2+10x+1}\) for every real \(x\), choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
solutions.title: Distribute from the inside outward
